title: Twice Upon a Time: Complementary Representations for Time-Series Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22327v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Time Series Language Models (TSLMs) enable language-based understanding and reasoning over temporal data, yet a fundamental question remains: what information should their time-series representations preserve, and what variation should they factor out? Existing TSLMs typically expose the language model to a single representation, imposing a fixed inductive bias across downstream tasks. We instead introduce complementary representations as a design principle for time-series reasoning. Our model combines two visual views: line plots preserve absolute measurements and the observed coordinate frame, while normalized delay embeddings factor out positive amplitude rescaling and offsets while exposing temporal structure. Dedicated visual encoders integrate both views into a shared language model through visual tokens and multi-level feature fusion. translated_title: 时光再现：面向时间序列推理的互补表示
translated_abstract: 时间序列语言模型（TSLMs）使得对时间数据进行基于语言的理解与推理成为可能，但一个根本问题仍然存在：其时间序列表示应当保留哪些信息，又应当剔除哪些变化？现有的TSLMs通常只向语言模型提供单一表示，从而在下游任务中施加了固定的归纳偏置。我们转而引入互补表示作为时间序列推理的设计原则。我们的模型结合了两种视觉视图：折线图保留绝对测量值与观测坐标系，而归一化的延迟嵌入则在剔除正幅度缩放与偏移的同时展现时间结构。专用的视觉编码器通过视觉标记和多级特征融合，将两种视图整合到共享的语言模型中。评估阶段的干预实验验证了这两种视图呈现出截然不同的不变性特征，……
tldr: 该论文提出以互补表示作为时间序列推理的设计原则，通过融合折线图与归一化延迟嵌入两种视觉视图，让时间序列语言模型既保留绝对测量信息，又剔除幅度缩放和偏移等变化。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes complementary representations as a design principle for time-series reasoning, combining line plots and normalized delay embeddings through dedicated visual encoders and multi-level feature fusion, enabling TSLMs to preserve absolute measurements while factoring out amplitude rescaling and offsets.
